lines: A server holding tens of thousands of records starts in seconds instead of minutes, and the Console's health page answers at once.
Reading a long list while a sync writes no longer fails with Access changed; the page waits a moment for the new records.
The Console's health page and a new chat no longer show buttons that do nothing.
In the schema map, every card stays clear of the others, opened or not, so each button can be pressed.
A Space with tens of thousands of records opens at once, and search, records, Files and chat answer in milliseconds.
Send a PDF for signature with no outside service. The signer needs no account, and the signed copy is sealed.
